cases_decision_valid.name: cases_decision_valid
cases_decision_valid.value: ("cases"."status"='decided') = ("cases"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "cases"."rationale" IS NOT NULL AND "cases"."decided_by_twitch_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cases"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

channels_live_owner_required.name: channels_live_owner_required
channels_live_owner_required.value: "channels"."origin" != 'live_twitch' OR ("channels"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."twitch_channel_id" IS NOT NULL)

channels_connection_owner_required.name: channels_connection_owner_required
channels_connection_owner_required.value: "channels"."connected_at" IS NULL OR ("channels"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."twitch_channel_id" IS NOT NULL)

flag_review_valid.name: flag_review_valid
flag_review_valid.value: "consistency_flags"."status"='open' OR ("consistency_flags"."review_note" IS NOT NULL AND "consistency_flags"."reviewed_by_twitch_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "consistency_flags"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

open_loops_terminal_reason.name: open_loops_terminal_reason
open_loops_terminal_reason.value: "open_loops"."status" NOT IN ('fulfilled', 'cancelled') OR length(trim("open_loops"."last_reason")) > 0 AND "open_loops"."last_reason" IS NOT NULL

open_loops_capture_origin.name: open_loops_capture_origin
open_loops_capture_origin.value: ("open_loops"."capture_method" = 'chat_command' AND "open_loops"."origin" = 'live_twitch') OR ("open_loops"."capture_method" = 'ai_review' AND "open_loops"."origin" IN ('live_twitch', 'manual_import')) OR ("open_loops"."capture_method" = 'dashboard' AND "open_loops"."origin" IN ('manual_import', 'demo_fixture'))

public_entry_approval_required.name: public_entry_approval_required
public_entry_approval_required.value: "public_entries"."status"!='published' OR ("public_entries"."approved_by_twitch_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "public_entries"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

repair_completion_valid.name: repair_completion_valid
repair_completion_valid.value: "repair_actions"."status" NOT IN ('completed','cancelled') OR ("repair_actions"."completion_note" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("repair_actions"."completion_note"))>0)
